name: Threats To Humanity
detailed_description:
Threats to Humanity: 

Defend Sacramento from an alien invasion!

In this action-packed arcade-style tower defense demo, you are humanity's last hope against waves of alien invaders, rogue robots, and devastating meteors!

Features:

  • Intense Levels: Battle through challenging levels set in iconic Sacramento locations.

  • Powerful Turrets: Deploy a variety of turrets, each with unique strengths and upgrade paths.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Face off against challenging mini-bosses that will test your skills.

  • Upgrade System: Upgrade your turrets and unlock new abilities to enhance your defenses.

  • Arcade Action: Experience fast-paced, addictive gameplay with vibrant visuals and explosive sound effects.
